That's a great PR. Two questions:
 - is the centered page title a new feature? I feel like the left aligned was better :) (just some personal preference here, not blocking)
 - do we plan to have a review by the anglophones at Algolia? I am not sure about some reformulation, but I'm no native :)

If you don't plan any change, I would merge this PR :+1:
